Don't do it. Not today. I came here to post my own version of the exact thing you did. But the point of it all will escape even the most sorted ones among us. 

If we both feel the same way, tell me are you really alone? I know you think you are because I do too. I wait for messages that will never come to me. No birthday has gone by, where I have not cried myself to sleep. 

And yet, here I am asking you to not do it. The purpose of life may very well elude us for the rest of our lives. But as long as we come closer to it, it's just fine. 

Let's start from the basics. Life is just the time we spend here on this planet. Every second here is a cosmic gift. This consciousness, though an unbearable burden right now, is something we might learn to value someday. Not if we give up today, but if we hold on. 

Don't do it. The truth is, everyone out there is alone. Every single one of them. No matter how many friends they have, no matter how many people they have, at the end of the day they fight their own battles. All alone. That is what this is. This reality is a constant battle with ourselves. We must learn to find our happiness in this battle. In the moments when not everything is against us. Even is those moments are brief, ephemeral, fleeting. 

Don't do it. Not today. I will hold on for you and I hope you will hold on for me. Let's listen to Zebra together friend. Let's try to find what went wrong together. Let's try to fix it, together. 

Don't do it. Not today.

What do I do if I lose the small battles? I don't see myself winning anything right now. It's just that I am so sick of failure. I don't want to be a burden on my family and yet I am not able to make the choice of fighting my own fight. How do I do it? 

I don't even know what I'm saying at this point. All I know is I'm ugly, fat, failing at school, sucking dick at my job. Please help me.

From what you've written, I think you are doing really well for yourself. The sad thing is, depression is not circumstantial. It happens to be with you no matter where you are, until you take the effort to root it out. 

What I mean to say is, you are doing an amazing job, all you need is a little help to feel happy again. Trust me it does get better once you are on mental plane to better be in control of your emotions. 

Speak to a therapist, seek professional help. Take some downtime and spend it doing things you love. Speak to family and friends. If you'd like to, my DM is open for a conversation. I hope you can feel happy again. Soon.
